description: This file defines a class implementing Spring Security's UserDetailsService to load user details from a custom UserService, including user roles and authorities.

classes.name: SpringDataUserDetailsService
classes.description: A service class implementing UserDetailsService to integrate custom user data with Spring Security.

methods.name: setUserService
methods.description: Setter method for injecting UserService dependency.

methods.name: loadUserByUsername
methods.description: Loads user details by username (email), throws exception if user not found, and constructs UserDetails with roles.
